title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
"I've been having some increased coughing lately."

HPI
The patient presents today for a routine follow-up visit regarding his COPD. He reports a cough that has been slightly more bothersome over the last week compared to his baseline, but denies any increased shortness of breath or wheezing that would significantly impact his daily activities. He states his usual rescue inhaler use frequency has remained similar to prior weeks. He denies fever, chest pain, or any acute exacerbations.

Medication List
Albuterol HFA inhaler, Tiotropium oral inhaler.

Exam
Vitals are stable. Lungs reveal diffuse bilateral wheezing without increased accessory muscle use noted. Cardiac exam is unremarkable.

Assessment
The patient has COPD. His current status is stable. We will monitor his symptoms and continue his current medication regimen.

Plan
The plan is to continue the current COPD management plan. Patient educated on early signs of worsening COPD and instructed to call the office if symptoms change significantly. He will monitor his symptoms at home.
explanations: The provider addressed COPD at this visit (status and plan documented), so it is supported and coded.

distractors.why: Status plus a plan in the assessment supports the diagnosis.

hccs.label: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease/Interstitial Lung Disorders/and Other Chronic Lung Disorders
